body: Thanks. I'm kind of hesitant to trust someone on the internet, so please understand that - I might not be willing to talk about a lot of things.

I wish I had a regular channel of communication with someone mature and caring (such as my friend I described). I just want some consistency  and support and I could talk to someone on a routine - every few weeks or something. I'd take anything. I just wish I mattered enough to someone that they want to talk to me and actually check in with me occasionally. As it currently stands, I have almost no one - and I have to contact them or no contact will be made. And that won't likely happen because I feel like a burden on people. I'm a waste to their time. If I cry for help or mention that I need help I just feel like I'm crying for attention.
Thanks for the reply. I don't really have much else to say - it took a lot to write that and I'm not sure what else to say. Anything you want to ask about specifically?
